newsitem.title: UK: Brent cargo trades at strong Aug Brent+5 cts-trade.
newsitem.headline: Brent cargo trades at strong Aug Brent+5 cts-trade.

text.p: A cargo of physical Brent crude oil traded on Monday at a strong August Brent +5 cents - up some 10 cents from last done, traders said.
The cargo, due to load in early August was taken out of the chains on Friday when an end July cargo moved at August Brent -5 cents.
Traders said the market was somewhat artificial and closer to a few traders' forward paper positions rather than physical demand.
"The ones who want it up looked likely to get it up today - and so they have. The price is not much of a surprise," one commented.
